governance.notes: The thingsboard GitHub organization owns thingsboard/thingsboard; the exact 4.3.1.8 POM attributes copyright to The Thingsboard Authors. The official contribution guide identifies the ThingsBoard team as issue reviewers and documents proposal feedback, tests, pull requests and CLA review; the exact-tag PR template requires issue/milestone references, compatibility and tests. See companion review for primary links and source hashes. Vendor/team-maintained project governance; no foundation status, multi-employer count or paid support entitlement is inferred.

activitySupport.notes: CE 4.3.x is Active LTS through 2027-07-20. Stable patch 4.3.1.8 was published within six months and documents delivered security fixes. The KEV expedite authorizes its shorter cooling-off.

securityProcess.notes: Private disclosure and response process; exact release notes document CVE fixes; official release API publishes SHA-256 checksums for three distribution assets. See companion review for primary links and hashes.

supplyChain.notes: No passing qualification recorded. Requires the full Linux current/candidate scan, net-improvement proof and ADR-0049 disposition. Two OpenJDK Critical proposals remain unapproved. This link is a workflow index, not scan evidence.
